name: Abandoned Mine
description: Timber-propped shafts, ore carts on rails and a flooded lower gallery.
palette: raw rock grey-brown, old timber, rust orange, lantern amber
lighting: pitch dark away from the lanterns, hard pools of warm glow
aesthetics: Hand-painted fantasy cartography, rough painterly brushwork with visible strokes, strong dark ink outlines around every object and wall, subtle black and brown linework, restrained desaturated colour, flat orthographic projection with every object drawn as its top surface and a short soft shadow cast beside it on the floor, inked line art over watercolour and gouache, premium hand-drawn D&D virtual tabletop map, dense environmental storytelling
ground: uneven rock floor of loose spoil and ore chippings, timber sleepers laid for rails
materials: An abandoned fantasy mine seen from above. Rough-hewn rock galleries with heavy timber props and cross-beams shoring the walls, narrow-gauge rails laid on sleepers with a tipped ore cart spilling rock, picks and shovels leaning against the stone, oil lanterns standing on the rock ledges, a windlass over a black vertical shaft, spoil heaps and loose scree, dark water flooding the lowest gallery, a partly collapsed side tunnel choked with fallen rock and splintered timber.
boundary: raw hewn rock, pick-marked and irregular, shored here and there with rough timber
